TC-AGENCY-037.title: Payment option blocks submission when none is selected
TC-AGENCY-037.blockReason: BLOCKED FOR AUTOMATION — the payment-option checkbox component cannot be driven reliably through the public UI with any interaction method available to this harness. NOT an application defect.

detail.userLevelExecution: Deselected all four selected payment options through the UI, confirmed the visible state showed none selected, filled Remarks, submitted.
detail.observedThreeTimes: The application accepted the submission (PUT /Admin2/agency/949 -> 204) and navigated to the list with a success toast.
detail.manualResult: The reviewer, executing by hand, observed the submission blocked with a Required message on Payment option — the correct behaviour.
detail.diagnosticOnly: A network capture showed the request still carried "paymentOptionIds":[197] while every visible checkbox read unchecked, so the component had not synchronised with the automated interaction. Recorded as DIAGNOSTIC evidence for the automation being unreliable. Deliberately NOT used as a test assertion: asserting on the request payload would make the test aware of the implementation it exists to verify from the outside.

TC-AGENCY-037.disposition: Application behaviour is verified MANUALLY and is correct. The case stays Blocked for automation until the PrimeNG checkbox interaction method is fixed. It is not an application defect and not an application-coverage gap.

TC-AGENCY-048.title: Approve a pending agency update
TC-AGENCY-048.blockReason: Only one credential exists on this install (odeysysadmin, Super Admin), so the submitter and the approver would be the same identity. The four-eyes separation this case exists to verify cannot be exercised, and approving one's own change under Super Admin would prove nothing about whether the platform permits it for anyone else (FINDING-007). The case's own Notes require Blocked here, never Passed or Failed.
TC-AGENCY-048.unblockedBy: A second, non-Super-Admin credential with approval rights.

TC-AGENCY-049.title: Reject a pending agency update with a reason
TC-AGENCY-049.blockReason: Same single-credential limitation as TC-AGENCY-048: rejection by a different user cannot be exercised with one identity (FINDING-007).
TC-AGENCY-049.unblockedBy: A second, non-Super-Admin credential with approval rights.

TC-AGENCY-052.title: Changing Branch re-inherits dependent values
TC-AGENCY-052.skipReason: Deferred / Requires Dedicated Environment. The case's own Notes mark it DEFERRED and forbid execution in this run: changing Branch may overwrite Product Access and Sales Contact values the agency already holds, which on this shared environment is a destructive and possibly unrecoverable change to a live commercial record.
TC-AGENCY-052.note: TC-AGENCY-041 demonstrated this risk concretely — a product deselection could not be undone through the UI — which supports the deferral rather than contradicting it.
